It also replaces two places that indexed DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] (one with a hard cast to PropertyDeclarationSyntax) with null-safe lookups, so members that come from metadata no longer throw. Separately, the MsgPack014 check in the analyzer now matches formatter type arguments that are Annotated instead of NotAnnotated. New generator tests compile a defining assembly to a metadata-only image, use closed generic structs and record structs from it as members, and check that there are no diagnostics and that the resolver is generated.
